```{r}
summarize_bone_sections_zero_na <- function(input_df, reference_df = elements_data) {
  # Filter out rows where input_df$element is 0 or NA
  input_df <- input_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(input_df$count) & input_df$count != 0)


  # Add bone info using the filtered input_df
  bone_info_df <- add_bone_info(input_df, reference_df)

  # Define the ordered list of skeleton sections
  sections_order <- c("Skull", "Hyoid", "Vertebrae", "Thorax", "Shoulder",
                      "Arms", "Hands", "Pelvic", "Legs", "Foot")

  # Summarize the minimum Level for each section
  summary_df <- bone_info_df %>%
    group_by(Skeleton_Section) %>%
    summarize(min_level = min(Level, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Create a named vector with all sections, initializing with 1 (instead of NA)
  result_vector <- setNames(rep(1, length(sections_order)), sections_order)

  # Fill in the result_vector with available data
  for (section in sections_order) {
    if (section %in% summary_df$Skeleton_Section) {
      level <- summary_df$min_level[summary_df$Skeleton_Section == section]
      # If the level is NA, keep it as 1, otherwise use the actual level
      result_vector[section] <- if(is.na(level)) 1 else level
    }
    # If the section is not in summary_df, it will remain 1
  }

  # Return just the numeric vector without names
  return(unname(result_vector))
}
```

```{r}
recal_mne_first <- function(current_mne, target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order) {
  
  current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)
  # Initialize an empty list to store new MNE results
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create the initial tibble with counts and elements
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names)
  
  # Add bone info to the tibble
  current_mne_named <- add_bone_info(current_mne_named)
  
  # Helper function to standardize names
  standardize_name <- function(name) {
    gsub(" ", ".", name)
  }

  # Loop over each part/section
  for (part_index in seq_along(sections_order)) {
    part <- sections_order[part_index]
    current_level <- current_levels[[part_index]]
    target_level <- target_levels[[part_index]]
    
    # Skip if already at or below target level
    if (current_level <= target_level) {
      part_data <- current_mne_named %>% filter(Skeleton_Section == part)
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(part_data))) {
        element <- standardize_name(part_data$element[i])
        count <- part_data$count[i]
        new_mne[[paste(part, element, sep = "_")]] <- count
      }
      next
    }
    
    # Initialize working data for this section
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>% 
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      mutate(std_element = standardize_name(element))
    
    # Process hierarchical reductions step-by-step
    while (current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        # Get the mapping for this step
        mapping <- category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]
        
        # Create element to category mapping
        element_to_category <- unlist(lapply(names(mapping), function(category) {
          std_category <- standardize_name(category)
          elements <- mapping[[category]]
          std_elements <- sapply(elements, standardize_name)
          setNames(rep(std_category, length(std_elements)), std_elements)
        }))
        
        # Map elements to target categories
        working_data$target_category <- element_to_category[working_data$std_element]
        
        # Aggregate counts by target category
        working_data <- working_data %>%
          filter(!is.na(target_category)) %>%
          group_by(target_category) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          mutate(
            element = target_category,
            std_element = standardize_name(target_category)
          ) %>%
          select(-target_category)
        
        # Update current level for next iteration
        current_level <- intermediate_level
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping for:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Store final results for this section
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
      element <- working_data$std_element[i]
      count <- working_data$count[i]
      new_mne[[paste(part, element, sep = "_")]] <- count
    }
  }
  
  # Convert new_mne to data frame
  new_mne_df <- tibble(element = names(new_mne), count = unlist(new_mne))
  
  return(new_mne_df)
}
```

```{r}
recal_mne_three <- function(current_mne,  target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order) {
  current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)
  # Initialize results list
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create initial tibble with bone info
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names) %>%
    add_bone_info() %>%
    mutate(std_element = gsub(" ", ".", element))
  
  # Process each skeleton section
  for (part in sections_order) {
    part_idx <- which(sections_order == part)
    current_level <- current_levels[part_idx]
    target_level <- target_levels[part_idx]
    
    cat("\nProcessing", part, ": Starting at level", current_level, "-> Target", target_level, "\n")
    
    # Initialize working data for this section
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>%
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      select(std_element, count)
    
    iteration <- 1
    while(current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      cat("  Step", iteration, ": Reducing from", current_level, "->", intermediate_level, "\n")
      
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        mapping <- category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]
        
        # Create element to category mapping
        element_map <- list()
        for (category in names(mapping)) {
          std_category <- gsub(" ", ".", category)
          element_map[[std_category]] <- sapply(mapping[[category]], function(x) gsub(" ", ".", x))
        }
        
        # Map and aggregate
        working_data <- working_data %>%
          mutate(target_category = sapply(std_element, function(x) {
            cats <- names(element_map)[sapply(element_map, function(y) x %in% y)]
            if(length(cats) > 0) cats[1] else NA_character_
          })) %>%
          filter(!is.na(target_category)) %>%
          group_by(target_category) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          rename(std_element = target_category)
        
        cat("    Current elements:", paste(working_data$std_element, collapse=", "), "\n")
        cat("    Current counts:", paste(working_data$count, collapse=", "), "\n")
        
        current_level <- intermediate_level
        iteration <- iteration + 1
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Special handling for pelvic section
    if(part == "Pelvic" && nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      cat("Applying pelvic adjustment\n")
      working_data <- working_data %>%
        mutate(count = case_when(
          std_element == "Os.Coxae" ~ count * 2,  # Bilateral adjustment
          TRUE ~ count
        )) %>%
        group_by(std_element) %>%
        summarize(count = sum(count))
      
      cat("  Final pelvic counts:", sum(working_data$count), "\n")
    }
    
    # Store results with section prefix
    if(nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
        element_name <- paste(part, working_data$std_element[i], sep = "_")
        new_mne[[element_name]] <- working_data$count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Handle empty results case
  if(length(new_mne) == 0) {
    return(tibble(element = character(), count = numeric()))
  }
  
  # Create ordered data frame
  result_df <- tibble(
    element = names(new_mne),
    count = unlist(new_mne)
  ) %>%
    mutate(element = factor(element, levels = names(new_mne))) %>%
    arrange(element) %>%
    mutate(element = as.character(element))
  
  cat("\nFinal target levels achieved:", target_levels, "\n")
  return(result_df)
}
```

```{r}
recal_mne_four <- function(current_mne,  target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order) {
  current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)

  # Initialize results list
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create initial tibble with bone info
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names) %>%
    add_bone_info() %>%
    mutate(std_element = gsub(" ", ".", element))

  # Process each skeleton section
  for (part in sections_order) {
    part_idx <- which(sections_order == part)
    current_level <- current_levels[part_idx]
    target_level <- target_levels[part_idx]
    
    cat("\nProcessing", part, ": Starting at level", current_level, "-> Target", target_level, "\n")
    
    # Initialize working data with explicit columns
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>%
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      select(std_element, count) %>%
      rename(element = std_element)  # Initial rename here

    iteration <- 1
    while(current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        # Create element-category mapping with clean names
        element_map <- stack(category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]) %>%
          setNames(c("child", "parent")) %>%
          mutate(
            child = gsub(" ", ".", child),
            parent = gsub(" ", ".", parent)
          ) %>%
          distinct()

        # Process through hierarchy level
        working_data <- working_data %>%
          left_join(element_map, by = c("element" = "child")) %>%
          filter(!is.na(parent)) %>%
          group_by(parent) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          rename(element = parent) %>%
          select(element, count)
        
        current_level <- intermediate_level
        cat("  Step", iteration, "| Level:", current_level, "| Elements:", nrow(working_data), "\n")
        iteration <- iteration + 1
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Store final results with section prefix
    if(nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
        element_name <- paste(part, working_data$element[i], sep = "_")
        new_mne[[element_name]] <- working_data$count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Convert to tibble with proper ordering
  new_mne_df <- tibble(
    element = names(new_mne),
    count = unlist(new_mne)
  )
  
  return(new_mne_df)
} 
```

```{r}
recal_mne_six <- function(current_mne,  target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order) {
    current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)

  
  # Initialize results list
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create initial tibble with bone info
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names) %>%
    add_bone_info() %>%
    mutate(std_element = gsub(" ", ".", element))

  # Process each skeleton section
  for (part in sections_order) {
    part_idx <- which(sections_order == part)
    current_level <- current_levels[part_idx]
    target_level <- target_levels[part_idx]
    
    cat("\nProcessing", part, ": Starting at level", current_level, "-> Target", target_level, "\n")
    
    # Initialize working data
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>%
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      select(std_element, count)

    iteration <- 1
    while(current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        # Create element-category mapping
        element_map <- stack(category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]) %>%
          setNames(c("child", "parent")) %>%
          mutate(
            child = gsub(" ", ".", child),
            parent = gsub(" ", ".", parent)
          )
        
        # Split data into mappable and non-mappable elements
        mappable <- working_data %>%
          inner_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        non_mappable <- working_data %>%
          anti_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        # Aggregate mappable elements
        aggregated <- mappable %>%
          group_by(parent) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          rename(std_element = parent)
        
        # Combine with non-mappable elements
        working_data <- bind_rows(non_mappable, aggregated)
        
        current_level <- intermediate_level
        cat("  Step", iteration, "| Level:", current_level, "| Elements:", nrow(working_data), "\n")
        iteration <- iteration + 1
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Store final results
    if(nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
        element_name <- paste(part, working_data$std_element[i], sep = "_")
        new_mne[[element_name]] <- working_data$count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Convert to tibble with proper ordering
  new_mne_df <- tibble(
    element = names(new_mne),
    count = unlist(new_mne)
  )
  
  return(new_mne_df)
}
```

```{r}
align_loaded_data <- function(one_skeleton, longer_elements, longer_counts) {

  shorter_elements <- sub(".*\\.", "",one_skeleton)
  longer_elements <- sub(".*\\_", "", gsub("\\.", " ", longer_elements)) 

  # Find the elements in the longer vector that are not in the shorter vector
  elements_to_remove <- longer_elements[!longer_elements %in% shorter_elements]

  # Find the positions of these elements in the longer vector
  positions_to_remove <- which(longer_elements %in% elements_to_remove)

  # Remove these elements and their corresponding counts from both vectors
  aligned_longer_elements <- longer_elements[-positions_to_remove]
  aligned_longer_counts <- longer_counts[-positions_to_remove]
  
  align_loaded_db <- tibble(element = aligned_longer_elements, count = aligned_longer_counts)
  
  return(align_loaded_db)
}


```

```{r}
# Define the vectors
elements <- c("Skull", "Mandible", "Hyoid", "Cervical", "Thoracic", "Lumbar", "Sternum")
counts <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)

elements2 <- c("Skull", "Mandible", "Hyoid", "Vertebrae", "Cervical", "Thoracic", "Lumbar", "Thorax", "Sternum")
counts2 <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)

# Function to align vectors by removing extra elements from both vectors
align_vectors <- function(elements1, elements2, counts2) {
  # Determine the shorter and longer vectors
  if (length(elements1) < length(elements2)) {
    shorter_elements <- elements1
    longer_elements <- elements2
    #shorter_counts <- counts1
    longer_counts <- counts2
  } else {
    shorter_elements <- elements2
    longer_elements <- elements1
    #shorter_counts <- counts2
    longer_counts <- counts1
  }

  # Find the elements in the longer vector that are not in the shorter vector
  elements_to_remove <- longer_elements[!longer_elements %in% shorter_elements]

  # Find the positions of these elements in the longer vector
  positions_to_remove <- which(longer_elements %in% elements_to_remove)

  # Remove these elements and their corresponding counts from both vectors
  aligned_longer_elements <- longer_elements[-positions_to_remove]
  aligned_longer_counts <- longer_counts[-positions_to_remove]

  return(list(shorter_elements = shorter_elements,aligned_longer_elements = aligned_longer_elements, aligned_longer_counts = aligned_longer_counts))
}

# Align the vectors
aligned_vectors <- align_vectors(elements,  elements2, counts2)

# Print the aligned vectors to verify
print(aligned_vectors$shorter_elements)

print(aligned_vectors$aligned_longer_elements)
print(aligned_vectors$aligned_longer_counts)
```
